audK1_a.text: This one is a yin amulet. A young lady. She passed away very young. A sad story. But she is very strong.

audK1_b.text: This one is a yin amulet. A young lady. She passed away very young. A sad story. But she is very strong.

audK2_a.text: This one is a yin amulet. A young lady. She passed away very young. A sad story. But she is very strong.

audK2_b.text: This one is a yin amulet. A young lady. She passed away very young. A sad story. But she is very strong.

audT1_a.text: You know, I have been watching you. The way you hold the pieces, you have a special sensitivity. Not many people have it.

audT1_b.text: You know, I've been watching you. The way you hold the pieces. You have a special sensitivity. Not many people have it.

audT2_a.text: You know, I've been watching you. The way you hold the pieces. You have a special sensitivity. Not many people have it.

audT2_b.text: You know, I've been watching you. The way you hold the pieces. You have a special sensitivity. Not many people have it.

audT3_a.text: You know, I've been watching you. The way you hold the pieces, you have a special sensitivity. Not many people have it.

audT3_b.text: You know, I've been watching you. The way you hold the pieces. You have a special sensitivity. Not many people have it.

mk4yatha_a.text: Yatowari wa ha. Pura. Pari printi sakurang. Awama wa itotinang. Patanang wupakapati.

mk4yatha_b.text: Yatavari wa ha. Pra. Pali printi sakarang. Awama wa ito tinang. Patanang wupakapati.

ow4hello_a.text: Ah, you came back. I was worried about you. After Buddha day...

ow4hello_b.text: Ah, you came back. I was worried about you after Buddha day.

ow4new_a.text: Come, come. I just got something new. Hanuman. Very powerful one. Come and see.

ow4new_b.text: Come, come. I just got something new. Hanuman. Very powerful one. Come and see.

ow4ok_a.text: Hey! Boy! What happened? Your face so pale!

ow4ok_b.text: Hey, boy, what happened? Your face so pale.

to4A1_a.text: Boy, boy, wake up and hear me or not.

to4A1_b.text: Moi! Moi! Wake up! Can you hear me or not?

to4A2_a.text: I'm sorry. I shouldn't have given you that one. Here, drink some water. Rest first.

to4A2_b.text: I'm sorry, I shouldn't have given you that one. Here, drink some water, rest first.

to4A3_a.text: You fell down. Shaking, talking in a voice. Not yours. 20 minutes you know.

to4A3_b.text: You fell down, shaking, talking in a voice, not yours. 20 minutes, you know.

to4B1_a.text: Okay, but treated with respecta. If anything happens, bring it back.

to4B1_b.text: Okay, but treat it with respect, huh? If anything happens, bring it back.

to4B2_a.text: Nevermind. Better like that. Don't worry about the money.

to4B2_b.text: Never mind. Better like that. Don't worry about the money.

to4C1_a.text: Yes, yes. Don't force. Some things are better left wrapped.

to4C1_b.text: Yes, yes. Don't fuss. Some things are better left wrapped.

to4C2_a.text: Combat any time, eh? Tea is always here.

to4C2_b.text: Come by any time, eh? Tea is always here.

to4D1_a.text: You know, you're right. I only collect them. I don't really know what is inside either.

to4D1_b.text: You know, you're right. I only collect them. I don't really know what is inside either.

to4D2_a.text: Go and see this temple. There's a monk there who teaches meditation. He will explain it properly. Not like me. Play, play.

to4D2_b.text: Go and see this temple. There's a monk there who teaches meditation. He will explain it properly. Not like me play play.

to4D3_a.text: Go. And this one. I'll keep it wrapped.

to4D3_b.text: Go. And this one, I'll keep it wrapped.

to4hello_a.text: Ah, you're here again. Come, sit, sit. I just made tea.

to4hello_b.text: Ah, you're here again. Come, sit sit. I just made tea.

to4lersi_a.text: Ah, you feel it, right? The Lersi, the old Hermit.

to4lersi_b.text: Ah, you feel it, right? The Lersi, the old Hermit.

to4naga_a.text: Phaya Naga. Wah. All three answer you.

to4naga_b.text: Koya Naga. Oha. All three answer you.

to4notice_a.text: You know, I've been watching you. The way you hold the pieces. You have a special sensitivity. Not many people have it.

to4notice_b.text: You know, I've been watching you. The way you hold the pieces. You have a special sensitivity. Not many people have it.

to4tray_a.text: Here, hold them one by one. Let your mind open and see what you feel.

to4tray_b.text: Here, hold them one by one. Let your mind open and see what you feel.

to4unknown_a.text: This one, even I don't know what is inside. It came from an old collection. Nobody could tell me. Maybe you can?

to4unknown_b.text: This one, even I don't know what is inside. It came from an old collection. Nobody could tell me. Maybe you can.

to4wess_a.text: Thao Wessuwan. Guardian of the North. Even he comes for you.

to4wess_b.text: Thao Wessuwan. Guardian of the North. Even he comes for you.

yk4gentle_a.text: Hold her gently. If she doesn't like you, put her down.

yk4gentle_b.text: Hold her gently. If she doesn't like you, put her down.

yk4hello_a.text: You're looking for something special, boy.

yk4hello_b.text: You're looking for something special, boy?

yk4merit_a.text: Go and make merit for Hula. Don't forget.

yk4merit_b.text: Go and make merit for Hulwa. Don't forget.

yk4show_a.text: This one is a yin amulet. A young lady. She passed away very young. A sad story. But she is very strong.

yk4show_b.text: This one is a yin amulet. A young lady. She passed away very young. A sad story. But she is very strong.

z4A1_a.text: I wanted to know. So I opened myself. All the way.

z4A1_b.text: I wanted to know. So I opened myself. All the way.

z4A1b_a.text: No. This isn't one of them. This isn't.

z4A1b_b.text: No. This isn't one of them. This isn't.

z4A2_a.text: Twenty minutes. I couldn't remember any of it.

z4A2_b.text: Twenty minutes. I couldn't remember any of it.

z4A3_a.text: I invited it in to prove it was there. It came. And I still couldn't tell you what it was.

z4A3_b.text: I invited it in to prove it was there. It came. And I still couldn't tell you what it was.

z4A4_a.text: For weeks after, I didn't feel alone. Not once.

z4A4_b.text: For weeks after, I didn't feel alone. Not once.

z4A_a.text: I opened the door to prove it was there. It came in.

z4A_b.text: I opened the door to prove it was there. It came in.

z4B1_a.text: How much, Uncle? I'll try it at home.

z4B1_b.text: How much, Uncle? I'll try it at home.

z4B1b_a.text: Okay, let's see what you are.

z4B1b_b.text: Okay, let's see what you are.

z4B2_a.text: I had told her I wouldn't bring her home. And here I was, bringing home something I couldn't even name.

z4B2_b.text: I had told her I wouldn't bring her home, and here I was, bringing home something I couldn't even name.

z4B3_a.text: I didn't sleep that night. Every sound in the room was it or me.

z4B3_b.text: I didn't sleep that night. Every sound in the room was it. Or me.

z4B4_a.text: I brought it back the next morning. Some things are not for testing alone.

z4B4_b.text: I brought it back the next morning. Some things are not for testing alone.

z4B_a.text: I brought it home and broke the promise I made to her.

z4B_b.text: I brought it home and broke the promise I made to her.

z4C1_a.text: Thank you, Uncle. But I think that's enough for today.

z4C1_b.text: Thank you, Uncle. But I think that's enough for today.

z4C2_a.text: I put it down and walked away. That much, I got right.

z4C2_b.text: I put it down and walked away. That much I got right.

z4C3_a.text: But I still didn't understand what I had been doing. Or what had been answering me.

z4C3_b.text: But I still didn't understand what I had been doing, or what had been answering me.

z4C4_a.text: And I knew, sooner or later, I would pick something up again.

z4C4_b.text: And I knew, sooner or later, I would pick something up again.

z4C_a.text: I put it down. I still didn't understand.

z4C_b.text: I put it down. I still didn't understand.

z4D1_a.text: Uncle, I don't want to test them anymore. I don't know what I'm letting in.

z4D1_b.text: Uncle. I don't want to test them anymore. I don't know what I'm letting in.

z4D2_a.text: Do you know anyone who can teach me properly? Someone who really knows?

z4D2_b.text: Do you know anyone who can teach me properly? Someone who really knows.

z4D3_a.text: Discernment. Respect. Proper guidance. That was the first time I asked for them.

z4D3_b.text: Discernment. Respect. Proper guidance. That was the first time I asked for them.

z4D4_a.text: You don't need to invite something in, just to prove that something is there.

z4D4_b.text: You don't need to invite something in. Just to prove that something is there.

z4D_a.text: I stopped testing and asked for a teacher.

z4D_b.text: I stopped testing and asked for a teacher.

z4cold_a.text: So cold. Like ice water in my veins.

z4cold_b.text: So cold. Like ice water in my veins.

z4dedicate_a.text: For the young lady of the amulet, may this merit reach you. May you be at peace.

z4dedicate_b.text: For the young lady of the amulet, may this merit reach you. May you be at peace.

z4fine_a.text: I'm okay, Uncle. Still trying to understand what happened.

z4fine_b.text: I'm okay, Uncle. Still trying to understand what happened.

z4han0_a.text: On another occasion, I was back at the shop I knew best.

z4han0_b.text: On another occasion, I was back at the shop I knew best.

z4hide_a.text: I couldn't let anyone see me like that. Not again. Not in public.

z4hide_b.text: I couldn't let anyone see me like that. Not again. Not in public.

z4lersi_a.text: Calm. And very old. Like sitting in a forest at night.

z4lersi_b.text: Calm. And very old. Like sitting in a forest at night.

z4look1_a.text: Little bottles of oil. With something floating inside. I didn't want to know what.

z4look1_b.text: Little bottles of oil. With something floating inside. I didn't want to know what.

z4look2_a.text: Old photographs. Nobody in them was smiling, and one of them had fresh flowers under it.

z4look2_b.text: Old photographs. Nobody in them was smiling, and one of them had fresh flowers under it.

z4look3_a.text: Red drinks. With straws in them. For someone who isn't here anymore.

z4look3_b.text: Red drinks. With straws in them. For someone who isn't here anymore.

z4naga_a.text: Water. Everywhere. And something moving in it.

z4naga_b.text: Water. Everywhere. And something moving in it.

z4pro1_a.text: After that night at the medium, I couldn't leave it alone. I needed to know what was happening to me.

z4pro1_b.text: After that night at the medium, I couldn't leave it alone. I needed to know what was happening to me.

z4pro2_a.text: I went from shop to shop. Amulets, masters, anyone who might know something.

z4pro2_b.text: I went from shop to shop. Amulets. Masters. Anyone who might know something.

z4pro3_a.text: One afternoon, on the top floor of an old mall, I found a shop I had never noticed before.

z4pro3_b.text: One afternoon on the top floor of an old mall, I found a shop I had never noticed before.

z4pro4_a.text: Nobody else was up there. Just an old song coming from that shop.

z4pro4_b.text: Nobody else was up there. Just an old song coming from that shop.

z4tem1_a.text: Later I went to a temple and made a contribution dedicated to her.

z4tem1_b.text: Later I went to a temple and made a contribution dedicated to her.

z4tem2_a.text: That experience has stayed with me ever since.

z4tem2_b.text: That experience has stayed with me ever since.

z4tray0_a.text: Eventually, there was one shop owner I visited often. He was the one who noticed.

z4tray0_b.text: Eventually there was one shop owner I visited often. He was the one who noticed.

z4urge_a.text: No. No. It wants to come in.

z4urge_b.text: No. No. It wants to come in.

z4yin_a.text: I will not bring you home, but I will make merits under your name.

z4yin_b.text: I will not bring you home, but I will make merits under your name.

to4A1_c.text: Boy! Boy! Wake up! Can you hear me or not?

to4A1_d.text: Boy! Boy! Wake up! Can you hear me or not?

to4C2_c.text: Come again any time, eh? Tea is always here.

to4C2_d.text: Come again anytime, huh? G is always here.

yk4merit_c.text: Go and make merit for her. Don't forget, ah?

yk4merit_d.text: Go and make merit for her. Don't forget, Thao.
